metadata.title: Shark puttu anyone
metadata.description: Shark Puttu – a true delicacy from the southern coast of India. This beautifully spiced and flaky dish made with tender shark meat is a coastal treasure, rich in flavor and tradition. Every bite is a burst of warmth, depth, and a taste of the sea – simple yet incredibly delicious!
